text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—The queen, Buena Vista! Feast your eyes 
upon her!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is the stride of the next ruler. 
Daaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ngh, Ruler-san... is so strong!

An intense statement. Rulership took on 
Buena Vista with an ingenious race 
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That was wonderful, Ruler-san!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, thank you, Buena. If it suits your 
fancy, would you care to show me the way?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I want you to show me too. The view that 
is currently closest to the "breathtaking 
scenery" you aim for.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san, this is the view of the Arima 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone in the audience, please give a 
big round of applause for Ruler-san's 
run!"
(WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, these cheers... Come to think of 
it... I had forgotten...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I'm... really not good with crowds~~~ The 
stares pierce right through me like 
sunlight, but...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Spectators! Do not dare take your eyes off 
my run! Ha ha ha...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Ruler. That was a race plan 
worthy of you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Will this be your final run for the year?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a new battle begins next year. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Next year, this Rulership shall prove to 
the world. That this Twinkle Series is—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's just a board game. In the end, it's 
purely strategy that dictates the outcome.

That night, Rulership was in high spirits 
over the race results...

...Or not. She was deep in serious 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"No, I was just thinking that this race's 
developments were rather irregular."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, when one player joins or leaves, it 
often completely changes the game."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—there's inevitably a lingering 
sense of dissatisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Rose... If you had been out there, I 
wonder what kind of race it would have 
been...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
How many cards do you currently hold in 
your hand? If only there were some way to 
find out.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm? Come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably... I have decided to forgo 
running in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It fills me with regret, but... this is 
for the clan's sake. We shall meet again 
at the New Year's garden.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The garden in "early spring"... Rose 
didn't say we'd meet "next spring."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Unless you've already shifted your mindset 
toward next spring's GⅠ races...

I've been brooding over it for a while 
now, but we have to decide on our next 
target race.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could you wait just a moment? There is 
someone I must contact.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: If my prediction is correct—

Rulership, who had stepped away for a 
while, came back.
choice_data_list: Did everything go okay with your errands?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it went off without a hitch. So, 
about what comes next, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, regarding our next goal, though—
Yeah, about our next goal, though...

text_block_list.text:
To prove oneself as the true ruler, the 
first milestone to aim for should be the 
Spring GⅠs.
Thinking in terms of the shortest route...
choice_data_list: Maybe the Osaka Hai in March or something.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: No, before starting a new game—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: We're going into extra innings, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the Arima Kinen is over, but... it 
didn't turn out to be the game I had 
anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There's a general I missed fighting. Until 
I race against him, I just can't feel 
satisfied.

The general who missed the battle. That is 
clearly Rose Kingdom. But where will he 
run?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The race we're aiming for is right before 
our eyes. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
January's GII, the Nikkei Shinshun Hai. 
That is the 'Garden of the New Spring' 
they speak of.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I just checked with Rose. Confirmed that 
she's scheduled to run the Nikkei Shinshun 
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Do you have any concerns, Trainer?

"...I think it over. She just ran the 
Arima Kinen, so the toll on her body is a 
concern. However..."

"It's not as if she's running GⅠs 
back-to-back. Besides, if that's where 
Rulership's heart is set..."
choice_data_list: No problem. Let's do it— overtime!
I'm fine. Let's do it— overtime!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I figured you'd say that. This extra 
round is a bit different in nature from 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's not a match between the top four 
contenders— it's a one-on-one showdown.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Come, Rose. Let us run. There is a reason 
why we must fight no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: For me—and for you too.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ruler...

Each holds their own hidden feelings. 
And—there are those who harbor entirely 
unexpected ones as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There are a few targets... who require 
surveillance.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Buena-san was strong as ever. Though in 
last year's Arima Kinen, I took first and 
Buena-san took second.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa, the newcomer on the rise, 
is strong too. However, even more than 
that—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: What threatens not "me," but "us"... is...
(WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: She's nothing like her. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I can feel... a shadow. A shadow that 
continues to spread.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A voice calls out to me. Telling me that 
'she must not be left alone.'

Looking ahead to the Senior Year—the hopes 
and ambitions of various stables 
intertwined.
